change: functions.cart.transform input cart.lines[].purchaseOption: the field was removed.
reason: Pre-release (gap G3, Nov 6 2026 extension audit): a line carries at most one purchase option of each app, so two apps (a subscription and another app's protection plan) never overwrite each other on one line. The single `purchaseOption` becomes `purchaseOptions`, the line's options sorted by id (one per app, empty for a one-time purchase); keeping a lone field beside the list would name one app's option arbitrarily. A function that read `line.purchaseOption === id` reads `line.purchaseOptions.includes(id)`.

change: sdk.packages/plugin-sdk/src/testing.d.ts#FunctionDeclaration:createPluginTestHarness: an existing signature changed or gained a required member.
reason: The test harness now runs an app under its plan's limits, as the platform does (default Free): the 51st platform call of a run is refused with quota_subrequests and recorded in the new `breaches`, ctx.api.call and ctx.http.fetch past 60 a minute are refused, and running jobs stop at the plan's count; `plan` says which plan it used, and the new optional `plan` and `clock` options choose the plan and move time for the per-minute limits. The result only gains members an app reads; nothing constructs it. An app test that passed while breaking on Free now fails, which is the point: such an app is stopped after five breaches in production. Pass `plan: "paid"` for a Paid-only app.
